# streaminginfo's 0x3adc240(flag, count, T*), 0x30-byte records: images at 0 (u32@0x2c + u32@0x20
# slots, 0x3aeae00), a bit array at 8 (align 4: 0x314d640(u32@0x20) = (n * 8 + 0x1f) >> 5 dwords),
# xmodelsurfs slots at 0x10 (u32@0x24), and at 0x18 u32@0x28 16-byte groups: u32@8 slots of an asset
# whose type is the group's u32@0xc, each loaded by the typed switch 0x3b22a60 (flag 0).

# xanim's 0x3b21430(flag, T*, xanim) behind 0x3b1f6f0 (its parent the xanim): 8 bytes; a u16 count
# at 0 of 0 then 12 bytes; else 32 bytes, then the indices: u16@0 + 1 bytes when the xanim's
# frame count u16@0x56 is under 0x100, else (u16@0 + 1) * 2 (0x3b21478); then 0x3b1fe20 over
# the struct at 0x20 (tail jump, flag 0).
### f33c4ef0
SELF|0x8
IF|u16@0x0 == 0
READ|12
ELSE
READ|32
IF|u16@%%0x56 < 0x100
READ|(u16@0x0 + 1)
ELSE
READ|((u16@0x0 * 2) + 2)
ENDIF
AT|0x20|f33c38e0
ENDIF

# scriptable's 0x3b09300 (0x20): any -1 / -2 at 0x18 is an array of u32@0x14 0xb0-byte events (align
# 8), each then read by 0x3b04fa0(0, &event[0x18], event): a cmp chain on the event's u32@0x10, each
# case a reader of the union at 0x18 (the transcriber dropped the loop at 0x3b093c2).
### f33aea40
SELF|0x20
IF|u64@0x18 != 0
IF|i64@0x18 == -1
ARRAY|u32@0x14|0xb0|mwiii_scriptable_event
ELSE
LIST|0x18|u32@0x14|0xb0|mwiii_scriptable_event
ENDIF
ENDIF

# 0x3b04f40(flag, count, T*): the scriptable events' array reader (nested events too: case 0x1d
# 0x3b08020), each event's union through 0x3b04fa0
### f33aa8b0

IF|u32@0x10 == 0
AT|0x18|f33ad5d0

# vhmdata's and stterrain's 0x3b108a0(flag, count, T*), 16-byte records {pointer, u32 size at 8, u32
# flags at 0xc}: a -1 / -2 pointer is (u32@0xc >> 31) ? u32@8 : 0 bytes (0x3b1093c), in the block and
# alignment of the context 0x3bbc7a0 pushed (0x3bbc440 / 0x3bbc420: no read of their own).
### f33b5f90
SELF|0x10
BYTES*|0x0|((u32@0xc >> 31) * u32@0x8)

# A streamed buffer {u32 size at 0, u32 flags at 4, pointer at 8, pointer at 0x10, u32 at 0x20}
# whose pointer at 0x10 is read by 0x3b10680(0, &s[0x10], &s): (u32@4 >> 31) ? u32@0 : 0 bytes;
# when u8@0x20 bit 0 is set too, by 0x3b106f0 under push(1) (align 32), else in place (align 128).
# 0x3b10680 is handed the struct (its parent argument) at T* - 0x10, which the tables cannot say:
# its callers enter this table at the struct instead (f3aea2f0 0x3aea4c2, f3aeb670 0x3aeb701,
# 0x3b0f919 and f3b0f610 with the struct at their own base).
### mwiii_blob
IF|((u32@0x4 >> 31) & 1) == 0
BYTES+|0x10|0
ELSE
IF|(u8@0x20 & 1) == 0
BYTES+|0x10|u32@0x0
ELSE
AT|0x0|mwiii_blob_temp
ENDIF
ENDIF

# ddl's 0x3ae3510 (0x58), a linked list the transcriber gives up on (over its budget): the name at
# 8 (-1 / -2: load_string 0x3bbcd90), at 0x20 i32@0x40 0x38-byte structs (0x3ae3950), at 0x28
# i16@0x44 0x28-byte records (a name at 0, i32@0x10 * 16 bytes at 8, i16@0x20 name slots at 0x18,
# 0x3b25590), then any non-zero 0x30 is the next node, read the same way (jmp 0x3ae3524).
### f3389e60
SELF|0x58
STR*|0x8
LIST*|0x20|i32@0x40|0x38|f338a2a0
LIST*|0x28|i16@0x44|0x28|mwiii_ddl_e28
SUB+|0x30|f3389e60

### mwiii_ddl_e28
SELF|0x28
STR*|0x0
BYTES*|0x8|(i32@0x10 * 16)
LIST*|0x18|i16@0x20|0x8|f33c8ea0

# ddl 0x3ae37b0 (0x10): under push(15), any non-zero 0x8 is the list above (0x3ae3830)
### f338a100

SUB+|0x8|f3389e60

# gfx_map_trzone's 0x3aebe90: its 0x20-byte records' streamed buffers {pointer, u32 size at 8, u32
# flags at 0xc} are read by 0x3b107a0 under the context 0x3bbc7a0 pushes, {0x10, 1, 1} (0x3aebfad):
# alignment 16 and block 1, the temporary block (0x3bbc440 / 0x3bbc7d0 push it), where every other
# caller's context keeps the buffer where it is. Its own copy of 0x3b107a0 learns that block.
### f33920d0_e1
SELF|0x20
AT|0x0|mwiii_trzone_buffer

### mwiii_trzone_buffer
SELF|0x10
IF|u64@0x0 != 0
IF|i64@0x0 == -1
READ|(((((u32@0xc >> 31) & 0xff) != 0) * u32@0x8) & 0xffffffff)
ELSE
BYTES|0x0|(((((u32@0xc >> 31) & 0xff) != 0) * u32@0x8) & 0xffffffff)
ENDIF
ENDIF
